bodyHtml:
🖥️ Fast, Secure & Hassle-Free · Logan & Surrounds

New Computer Setup Logan. Done Right, From The First Boot.

Got a brand-new computer? Exciting, but now comes the frustrating part. Our expert new computer setup service ensures your new PC, Mac or laptop is fully installed, transferred, secured and optimised, so it's ready to go from day one.

Set Up My New Computer
✓ Windows & macOS Setup
✓ Data Transfer
✓ Antivirus & Security
✓ Performance Tune-Up
✓ On-Site or Remote
Why It Matters

A New Computer Doesn't Come Ready To Use.

Do you need Windows or macOS installed and configured properly? Want to transfer your files across from an old PC or Mac without losing anything? Unsure which software and security settings you actually need? Most people end up guessing their way through it, or leaving important security settings switched off.

Our Approach

We Make New Computer Setup Stress-Free.

Computer Repairs Logan handles everything needed to get your new computer up and running smoothly, from operating system setup and data transfer to antivirus configuration and performance tuning, so your new PC, Mac or laptop is fully optimised, secure and ready to go.

What's Included

Our Professional New Computer Setup Services.

We handle everything you need to get your computer up and running smoothly.

💻

Complete Computer Setup

For PCs, Macs, desktops and laptops of any brand.

🪟

Windows or macOS Install & Updates

Get the latest operating system installed and updated correctly.

📁

Data Transfer & Backup

Safely migrate files, photos and documents from your old computer.

🧩

Software & Application Install

Microsoft Office, browsers, and any other software you rely on.

🛡️

Antivirus & Security Configuration

Protect your new computer from threats from the very first day.

🖨️

Network & Printer Setup

Connect to WiFi and peripherals without the hassle.

⚡

Performance Optimisation

Settings tuned for the best possible speed out of the box.

🎛️

Custom Preferences & Personalisation

We tailor the setup to exactly how you like to work.

Need something specific? Just ask, get in touch and we'll customise our service to fit your needs.

How It Works

Our Setup Process.

Available on-site at your home or office, or remotely, whichever suits you.

1️⃣

Consultation

Tell us what you need, we discuss your setup preferences first.

2️⃣

Installation & Configuration

We install software, update drivers, and optimise settings.

3️⃣

Data Transfer & Security Setup

We migrate your files and set up your security measures.

4️⃣

Final Optimisation & Training

We confirm everything works and guide you through your new setup.

Why Choose Computer Repairs Logan

Setting Up A New Computer Doesn't Have To Be Difficult.

  • Experienced Technicians, 10+ years of expertise in IT and tech support.
  • On-Site & Remote Services. Flexible options for your convenience.
  • Personalised Setup. We customise everything to your needs.
  • 100% Secure & Private. We protect your data and privacy throughout.
  • Same-Day Service Available. Get up and running fast.
  • No Hidden Fees. Transparent, affordable pricing.
Set Up My New Computer
Related Services

Setting Up Something Else Too?

Building a new machine from scratch instead of buying one off the shelf? Check out our custom computer build service. Already got your new computer set up and want ongoing peace of mind? We can also handle regular computer tune-ups, install the software you need with our software install & setup service, and lock down your accounts properly with password manager & 2FA setup. Setting up a new phone or tablet alongside your computer? See our mobile device setup service.

Frequently Asked Questions

New Computer Setup Questions, Answered.

How long does a new computer setup take?

Most setups are completed within 1 to 2 hours, depending on how much software needs installing and how much data needs transferring.

Can you transfer files from my old computer?

Yes. We safely migrate documents, photos and software from your old PC or Mac to your new one.

Do you set up both Windows and Mac computers?

Absolutely, we support Windows PCs, Macs, and Linux systems.

Can you install Microsoft Office and other software?

Yes, we install essential software including Microsoft Office, Zoom, and anything else you need.

How much does a professional setup cost?

Our pricing is affordable and transparent, get in touch for a straight quote over the phone.

Do you provide remote setup services?

Yes, we can configure most setups remotely as well as on-site.

Can you optimise my new computer for better performance?

Yes, we remove bloatware, update drivers, and tweak settings for peak performance from day one.

Do you offer business computer setup services?

Yes, we handle setups for businesses and work-from-home professionals as well as home users.

Start Fresh With A Perfectly Set Up Computer.

Fast & secure setup for PCs, Macs and laptops, on-site or remote, no hidden fees.
